source: ASME B31.3-2024, Table A-1 (SI units). Slice 3 of 3. Transcribed from a purchased copy held outside version control.
note: The S in t = P*D / (2*(S*E*W + P*Y)) - the most consequential number in B31.3, and the one this repo refused to guess at for two slices. Every value here survived a structural join; only the ones that also agree with the Code’s own basis are citable.

conventions.twoGatesNotOne: Parsing is not verification. Table A-1 joins identity to stresses across separate page blocks by a line number that RESTARTS in every material section, so a mis-join is silent. A value is citable only if the join held AND the room-temperature figure agrees with para. 302.3.2, S = min(UTS/3, 2/3 x yield), computed from tensile and yield figures that came from the ASTM specifications rather than from this table.
conventions.belowTheBasisIsNormal: A value below the basis is expected: a class or condition, a weld joint efficiency, or a time-dependent criterion can govern instead. It is held rather than cited because it is not independently confirmed - not because it is thought wrong.
conventions.aboveTheBasisIsImpossible: The Code never allows more than the basis. There are none, and that is the evidence the join held: a mis-join scatters values in BOTH directions.
conventions.siOnly: Only Table A-1 (SI) is transcribed. Table A-1C is the same curves in ksi and holding both would give one question two answers.

basisClause.note: Simplified: 302.3.2 has further criteria for time-dependent behaviour and for particular product forms. It is used here as an INDEPENDENT CHECK on a transcription, not as a way of computing S.
